lastCompletedStory.title: Clear stale review findings on a CLEAN verdict

openQuestions: US-001's open question (a latent selectFn-throw gap in buildProductionDispatchFn's meta_loop=auto dispatch path, src/commands/sidecar.ts ~1504/1509) is still unresolved and out of scope for US-002/US-003/US-004; carry it forward as a follow-up-story candidate, not something to fix opportunistically.
nextStoryContext: All 4 non-operator stories in this PRD (CAM-115) now have passes:true (US-001..US-004). US-004: makeReviewDispatch's CLEAN write path in src/supervisor/review.ts (~line 520) now destructures findings out of prd.review before spreading, so a CLEAN verdict no longer carries forward a prior FIXES_PENDING round's stale findings array (key-removal, not empty-array, to match the existing tag-based-path convention). MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT write paths (review.ts and loop.ts) were deliberately left untouched per the story's CLEAN-only scope. New regression test in test/supervisor/review.test.ts drives two sequential makeReviewDispatch calls (FIXES_PENDING round persisting file findings, then CLEAN round) and asserts prd.review.findings is undefined after the CLEAN write. file-size-budget.json ceilings raised for both files (review.ts 642->647, review.test.ts 1605->1642) with a CAM-115 tracker ref. Full quality spine (bun run check:all: test 3755 pass/0 fail, lint ok, file-size ok, debt-markers ok, version-skips ok, coverage ok, dead-code ok, dup ok, ci-parity ok) is green. There is no next non-operator story to implement: the next cam-loop iteration should proceed to /cam-review (review cycle), not another /cam-next implement dispatch.
